answer.reason: The verses tell of events at Ephesus beyond what the summary says: the burning of the books and the uproar over Diana.

clauses.english: was where many believers burned their books of curious arts before all men
clauses.quote: brought their books together, and burned them before all men

clauses.english: was thrown into an uproar by silversmiths angry at Paul's teaching against Diana
clauses.quote: Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
